name: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (fawryforbankingtechnologyandelectronicpaymentssae) is served under two keys, EGS745L1C014.CA PE 25.33 and FWRY PE 25.51, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 128.29 percent a year from FY2022 (2.11609e+08) to FY2025 (2.51753e+09), over 3 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 3.40652e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 3.40652e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.peRouteNote: The P/E reproduces from the market capitalisation and the FY2025 net profit, but the EPS on file is that same net profit over the same share count, so the per-share route and the cap route are one arithmetic: this agreeing flag is a reproduction check, not an independent one.

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 16.12) to the price on 2026-10-05
